projectDescription: An interactive Spanish-language educational web portal exploring the relationship between NASA and the U.S. Navy, featuring detailed scientific articles, an integrated AI assistant, arcade mini-games, and a historical timeline.
keyFeatures: Interactive AI assistant specialized in NASA and U.S. Navy topics (no regional restrictions)
Two arcade mini-games: space rocket mission and deep-sea explorer
Expandable accordion knowledge cards covering NASA–Navy history
2020–2026 historical milestones timeline (Artemis I, Artemis II)
Curated official sources: NASA, US Navy, NOAA Ocean Explorer
Dark-space visual theme with glassmorphism UI built with Tailwind CSS
publicApiSurface: handleUserChat(event) — submit question to local AI assistant
switchGame(mode) — toggle between 'space' and 'ocean' arcade modes
startGame() — initialize and run the arcade canvas game loop
triggerJump() — player impulse action (spacebar / click / touch)
